purpose: State-scoped coverage inventory for Kentucky 2024 result, review, turnout, map, historical, and election-administration context sources. This inventory records source availability and blockers; it does not promote production data and does not allege fraud or misconduct.
authorityPriority: Official Kentucky State Board of Elections, county clerks, county boards of elections, official GIS/Census, EAC, and official court/board records first; secondary sources are context only and caveated.

loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: scripts/extract-ky-recap-pdf-text.mjs to civic_etl/native.py _kentucky_general_recap_rows via etl/state-configs/ky.json certifiedResults.format=kentuckyGeneralRecapTextDirectory and reviewCharts.format=kentuckyGeneralRecapTextDirectory
caveats: County recap PDFs are official state-hosted artifacts, but the parser consumes extracted text because the Python ETL has no PDF parser dependency.
Elliott County official PDF is image-only; the derived text artifact includes a manual transcription from rendered official PDF pages.
U.S. House is district-based, and some counties have uncontested or county-only rows, so advisory review rows remain source-screening context rather than findings.
EAC rows are official national fallback turnout context.
Kentucky State Board turnout PDFs were collected in this pass but are not yet normalized into the active turnout contract.

loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: Not yet normalized; candidate parser should reconcile the State Board turnout PDFs against EAC fallback rows and the October 11, 2024 general registration statistics PDFs before replacing turnout.format=eacTurnoutCsv.
caveats: The State Board turnout page says turnout reports cannot accurately be compared to the election results page because they are run after voter-registration rolls reopen.
The same page says the turnout statistics should be considered unofficial and official documentation can be obtained from the County Clerk's office.

The county turnout PDF reports 2,086,320 voters and 3,548,136 registered voters statewide, while the current EAC fallback rows report 2,086,090 ballots cast with the same registered-voter denominator; reconcile before replacing the loaded EAC fallback.
County geometry supports current county result map joins.
Precinct boundary geometry is not included.
Historical rows are contextual county baselines only, not 2024 certified data.
The collection script validates statewide Democratic, Republican, and total-vote sums against candidate total rows in the official PDFs.

loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: scripts/normalize-verifiedvoting-equipment.mjs; surfaced through data/admin-source-packages.json and API equipment context paths
caveats: Do not infer every precinct or ballot mode used one identical setup; do not use this as vote, turnout, audit, or incident evidence.

officialSourceSearchPath.result: Official county recap PDF index and county PDFs are loaded; extracted text drives the native parser.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: Some counties are county-only or have one-sided/uncontested U.S. House comparison coverage; Elliott County required manual transcription from the official image-only PDF.

officialSourceSearchPath.result: 2024 General Voter Turnout by County and by Precinct PDFs were collected as candidate state-native turnout leads.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: The page states turnout reports are unofficial and can differ from election results because they are run after voter rolls reopen; county-clerk documentation or a reconciliation parser is needed before replacing EAC fallback turnout.

officialSourceSearchPath.result: October 11, 2024 general registration statistics PDFs by county and precinct were collected as denominator leads.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: Registration PDFs alone do not provide ballots-cast/voting counts and must be reconciled with turnout rows before serving as active turnout denominators.

officialSourceSearchPath.sourceAuthority: Kentucky State Board of Elections and county clerks
checkedFor: incident, correction, recount, and litigation records
officialSourceSearchPath.result: The State Board publishes a county-clerk directory and points turnout users to county clerks for official turnout documentation.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: No statewide CVR, incident/correction, recount, or litigation row package is loaded; custody is likely county-specific for several record families.

checkedFor: precinct boundary or reporting-unit geometry lead
officialSourceSearchPath.result: The State Board publishes county election plans, but the current page exposes 2026 primary plans rather than 2024 general precinct boundary geometry.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: No map-ready official statewide 2024 precinct boundary GeoJSON/shapefile or result-to-precinct crosswalk was identified in this pass.

officialSourceSearchPath.result: The page lists systems certified by the Kentucky State Board of Elections, including ES&S and Hart versions relevant to county equipment context.
officialSourceSearchPath.blocker: The page is certification context rather than county-level assignment history, audit outcome, CVR, or incident evidence.

official precinct boundary geometry or a publishable reporting-unit crosswalk matching 2024 recap precinct labels
post-election audit selection/outcome records if published or obtainable
CVR availability statements or request guidance by county, including ballot-secrecy/redaction caveats
official incident, correction, recanvass/recount, and litigation records for 2024 contests
preferredAuthorities: official county or state GIS offices
official Kentucky court or board docket sources for litigation/recount records
requestFields: ballots cast or voter participation count
precinct boundary geometry or reporting-unit crosswalk
audit selection unit, batch/precinct, hand-count and machine-count fields where available
CVR, ballot image, tabulator/EMS log, L&A, chain-of-custody, incident, correction, recanvass/recount, and litigation record identifiers where public or lawfully releasable
requestPath.publicContactPath: Use the Kentucky State Board of Elections contact path and county-clerk directory; preserve county-custody caveats before normalizing any county-held records.

confidenceNotes: Official 2024 result/review rows and official 2012/2016/2020 county historical baselines are loaded from Kentucky election-results artifacts.
